sculpt_cart.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_cart.notes: Sculpted two-wheeled hand-cart (spoked wheels with iron tyres, gapped plank bed, low sides with a patched board, long shafts with worn grips and a pull bar, a prop leg). No awning: height 0.85 m instead of 1.89. Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures: batched prop. Families wood (Wood_wood, DarkWood_wood, Red_wood) / metal (Stone_Dark_metal).
